blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The No Contact Apprehension Policy (NCAP) should not penalize motorists for circumstances “beyond their control,” such as poor road conditions, unclear signage and defective infrastructure, 1-Rider party-list Rep. Rodge Gutierrez said Sunday. Gutierrez said the party echoed motorists’ concerns over the system’s readiness for reimplementation, adding that it should be applied fairly and consistently while protecting the rights and safety of all road users, particularly motorcycle riders. “We will closely monitor the same, to the end that it is applied fairly, consistently, and with due regard for the rights and safety of all road users, particularly motorcycle riders,” […]...
